notes.title: RollerCoaster Tycoon 3: Platinum 33% Off for a Limited Time! 9 New Languages added via Steam Update!
notes.notes:
Dear RollerCoaster Tycoon 3: Platinum Players: 

We are pleased to announce the addition of 9 new languages to the Steam version of RCT3: Platinum! These are available now as a FREE automatic update to all RCT3: Platinum players on Steam! Newly added languages include: Dutch, Danish, Finnish, French, German, Italian, Norwegian, Spanish and Swedish. 

As an added bonus, we are discounting RCT3: Platinum by 33% for a limited time!

Please note, although we do not anticipate any issues with Saved Games at this time, you should as a precaution backup your Saved Games before updating the game. We suggest creating a backup of the entire RCT3 Saved Game directory (listed below). 

Saved Games, for most players, can be found at the following location on your computer: 
C:\Users\your_computer_username\Documents\RCT3 

Enjoy and stay tuned to http://www.rollercoastertycoon.com/ for more updates on the franchise and the next great PC game in the series - RollerCoaster Tycoon World!

Cheers, 
The RCT Team
